name: Initiative ID
githubSync: Shown in issue body as backlink.
description: Stable ID (R-01...) so other sheets and dashboards can point to a row

name: Roadmap Category
allowedText: New big bets · Grow customer revenues · Protect customer revenues · Operational efficiency · Close capability gaps
githubSync: Optional: push as label (off by default).
description: New big bets, Grow customer revenues, Protect customer revenues, Operational efficiency, Close capability gaps

name: Build Status
allowedText: Not started · In progress · Done · Cancelled
githubSync: GitHub -> app, read-only. Fixed vocabulary shared with Jira: tracking issue closed as completed -> Done; closed as not planned -> Cancelled; reopened -> Not started; first child issue in progress -> In progress. Counts from Gate B (Define to Build) onward. Applied automatically, audit-logged.
description: On Track, At Risk, Delayed, Blocked and so on

name: Initiative Phase
allowedText: Discover · Define · Build · Beta-test · Experiment · Roll-out · Completed · Sunset
githubSync: Suggest only (never auto-set): first child issue in progress -> suggest Build.
description: Discover, Define, Build, Beta-test, Experiment, Roll-out, Completed, Sunset

name: Stack Rank
githubSync: Optional one-way push to a GitHub issue field "Priority" / label.
description: Single priority order across the roadmap (1 = first)

name: Initiative Group
description: Theme that groups initiatives (for example bidding, partners, formats)

name: Initiative Name
githubSync: App -> GitHub issue title on creation; app owns the title afterwards.
description: Initiative name

name: Focus Area
description: Formats, Demand/Optimisation, Publishers, Backlog (as in v1)

name: Change Type
allowedText: New feature · Improvement to existing feature
description: New feature, or Improvement to existing feature

name: Initiative Hypothesis (IF / THEN / RESULTING IN)
githubSync: App -> GitHub: included in the managed block of the issue body.
description: IF we do X, THEN Y happens, RESULTING IN metric Z. Add 'BECAUSE' with evidence if known

name: Artifacts (links)
githubSync: App -> GitHub: listed in managed block of issue body.
description: Links to spec, PRD, design, experiment results

name: Comments
githubSync: Not synced. GitHub comments are shown read-only in the drill-down panel.
description: Free text, including notes copied from Roadmap v1

name: Sponsor
description: Person who asked for or owns the case for the initiative

name: Request Origin
allowedText: Customer · Sales · Leadership · Product analysis · Partner / vendor · Competitor move
description: Who or what triggered the request: Customer, Sales, Leadership, Product analysis, Partner / vendor, Competitor move

name: Customers Requesting (#)
description: Number of customers who asked for it (evidence of demand)

name: Product Manager
description: Product manager responsible

name: Engineering Manager
description: Engineering manager responsible

name: Designer
description: Designer, if any

name: Analyst
description: Analyst who measures it

name: Business Manager
description: Commercial owner (Demand, Publishers, Marketing)

name: Primary KR (Metric Name)
description: The one metric the initiative should move

name: Primary KR Start Value
description: Baseline value of that metric

name: Primary KR Target Value
description: Target value of that metric

name: Business Value Type
allowedText: New revenue · Increase revenue · Defend revenue · Decrease costs · Other
description: Always one of: New revenue, Increase revenue, Defend revenue, Decrease costs, Other

name: Business Value (12m run-rate)
description: Single universal value in the organization currency as a 12-month run-rate, comparable across all initiatives for stack ranking

name: Business Value Basis
allowedText: Measured · Estimate (basis stated) · Partner claim · Not stated
description: Measured, Estimate (basis stated), Partner claim, Not stated

name: Time to First Revenue (months)
description: Months from start of work until the first revenue or saving shows up

name: Confidence
description: High, Medium, Low confidence in the value

name: Effort (T-shirt)
githubSync: Optional: push to GitHub issue field "Effort" / label size:M.
description: T-shirt size

name: MoSCoW
description: Must, Should, Could, Won't

name: Estimate low (weeks)
description: Estimate low, in weeks

name: Estimate high (weeks)
description: Estimate high, in weeks

name: Confidence-weighted Value (EUR)
description: Value multiplied by the confidence factor (High 90%, Medium 60%, Low 30%; factors editable on the Lists sheet) (formula)

name: Weighted Value per Build-Week (EUR)
description: Confidence-weighted value divided by the high build estimate in weeks: first ranking signal (formula)

name: Cost of Not Doing (strategic risk)
description: What happens if we do not do it (lost revenue, churn, competitive gap, compliance)

name: Dependencies / Blockers
githubSync: Phase 2: GitHub "blocked by" on the tracking issue raises a Blocked suggestion.
description: What it waits on

name: Depends On (Initiative IDs)
githubSync: Phase 2: map to GitHub issue dependencies when both items are linked.
description: Initiative IDs this one cannot start or finish without, for example R-12; R-20

name: Related / Overlaps With (Initiative IDs)
description: Initiative IDs that overlap or share scope, to avoid double work and double counting

name: Decision
allowedText: Go · Hold · Kill · Not yet decided
description: Go, Hold, Kill, Not yet decided

name: Decided By
description: Person or forum that made the decision

name: Decision Date
description: Date of the decision

name: Next Review Date
description: Date to revisit the initiative so the roadmap does not go stale

name: Planned Quarter
description: Calendar quarter the work is planned for, chosen by a person

name: Start Date
description: Date work started

name: G2M Date (est)
githubSync: Optional: push to GitHub issue field (date) / milestone due date.
description: Planned go-to-market date

name: G2M Date (actual)
description: Actual go-to-market date (ends the last stage)

name: Start Discovery
description: Stage start dates drive the time columns

name: Start Definition
description: Date this stage started; drives the stage time formulas

name: Start Building
githubSync: Suggested from first child issue moving to in progress.
description: Date this stage started; drives the stage time formulas

name: Start Beta-Test
description: Date this stage started; drives the stage time formulas

name: Start Experiment
description: Date this stage started; drives the stage time formulas

name: Start Roll-Out
description: Date this stage started; drives the stage time formulas

name: Last Updated
description: Date the row was last reviewed

name: Audience
description: Publishers, Demand partners, Brands and agencies, Internal, Mixed

name: Target Markets
description: Intended scope: markets, publishers or partners

name: Live Markets
description: Scope that is live now

name: Target Customers (#)
description: Number of customers in the target scope

name: Customers Live (#)
description: Number of target customers live now

name: Roll-out %
description: Roll-out progress: 0%, 25%, 50%, 75%, 100%

name: % Adoption (live / target customers)
description: Customers live divided by target customers (formula)

name: GTM / Enablement Notes
description: Enablement: sales, ops, publisher comms, release notes, pricing or terms changes

name: Realized KR Value
description: Measured value of the primary KR

name: % Realized KR Value
description: Realized value as a share of target (formula)

name: Realized EUR per year
description: Measured euros per year

name: Measured Period
description: Period the realized value covers

name: Outcome Verdict
description: Hit, Partial, Miss, Too early

name: Learning
description: What we learned

name: Discovery Time (days)
description: Days from stage start to the next stage start (formula)

name: Definition Time (days)
description: Days spent in this stage (formula)

name: Building Time (days)
description: Days spent in this stage (formula)

name: Beta-Test Time (days)
description: Days spent in this stage (formula)

name: Experiment Time (days)
description: Days spent in this stage (formula)

name: Roll-Out Time (days)
description: Days spent in this stage (formula)

name: Time to Market (days)
description: Days from Start Date to G2M Date (actual) (formula)

name: Actual Build (weeks)
description: Building time in weeks (formula)

name: Build vs Estimate High (%)
description: Actual build weeks versus Carlos's high estimate (formula)

name: Blocked Days
githubSync: Phase 2: also from GitHub "blocked" label / blocked-by.
description: Days blocked

name: Support Hours Saved per Month
description: Hours of support saved per month, where that is the claim

name: Source
description: Where the row came from

name: Summary (participant-facing)
description: Plain-language, 1-2 sentences (max ~280 chars). Shown to participants in alignment sessions and on shared roadmaps.

name: Health
allowedText: On Track · At Risk · Delayed · Blocked
githubSync: Never auto-set. GitHub signals only create suggestions.
description: Human judgement on delivery health. Split out of v2 Initiative Status.

name: Horizon
description: Now/Next/Later bucket for the roadmap view. Empty = unscheduled.

name: Tags
description: Free tags for ad-hoc filtering.

name: Planned Start
githubSync: Optional: push to GitHub issue field (date).
description: Planned start of work. Together with G2M Date (est) forms the Gantt bar.

name: G2M Slip (days)
description: Current G2M Date (est) minus the first estimate recorded after Decision = Go.

name: Primary KR Unit
description: Unit of the primary KR.

name: Primary KR Direction
description: Whether the KR should go up or down.

name: Estimate Basis
allowedText: Engineering-sized · PM estimate · Rough guess · Not stated
description: Who/what the weeks estimate is based on.

name: Assignees
githubSync: Two-way with the tracking issue assignees; last write wins, audit-logged.
description: People working on the item. Mapped to GitHub logins; unmapped GitHub users show as external.

name: GitHub Links
githubSync: Created from the app or linked to an existing issue.
description: Linked issues/PRs: repo, number, role (tracking issue / child).

name: GitHub Sync State
allowedText: Not linked · Synced · Pending · Conflict · Error
description: State of the link with the tracker.

name: GitHub State
description: State of the tracking issue.

name: Issues Closed (#)
description: Closed child issues (sub-issues) across linked repos.

name: Issues Total (#)
description: All child issues.

name: Delivery Progress %
description: Closed / total child issues (empty when there are none).

name: Open PRs (#)
description: Open pull requests linked to the item.

name: Last GitHub Activity
description: Last commit/comment/state change on linked issues.

name: Merged PRs (#)
description: Merged pull requests linked to the item.

name: Delivery Status
githubSync: Projects v2 -> app, read-only (the board's Status field, in real time through the projects_v2_item event and at every check).
filledWhen: After the initiative is on the board
description: Where the initiative stands on the linked GitHub Project board, in the board's own words (for example Backlog, Ready, In progress, On staging, Done). Read from the board, never written by Product Velocity, and separate from Build Status (the issue's open or closed state) and from Initiative Status (set by people).

name: Iteration / Sprint (GitHub)
description: Current iteration of the tracking issue or its active child issues in the linked Project.

name: GitHub Target Date
description: Target/end date set on the item in the linked GitHub Project, if any.

name: Blocked Issues (#)
description: Child issues that are blocked (blocked-by relation or "blocked" label).

name: Stale Issues (#)
description: Open child issues with no activity for N days (project setting, default 14).

name: Scope Added (#)
description: Child issues created after the item entered Build.

name: Schedule Variance (pp)
description: Delivery Progress % minus share of time elapsed between Planned Start and G2M Date (est). Negative = behind plan.

name: Latest Release
description: Latest release/tag (name, date) in the linked repositories since the item started.

name: CI Status
description: Status of checks on the default branch of the primary repo.

name: Repositories
description: Repositories that contain linked issues.

name: Crowd Rank
description: Rank from the latest closed alignment session that included the item.

name: Crowd Score
description: Aggregated score (e.g. Borda or average ICE).

name: Consensus
description: 0-100 agreement between participants (low = polarising).

name: Votes (#)
description: Number of verified ballots including the item.

name: Visibility
description: Controls whether an item may appear in shared roadmaps and alignment sessions.

name: Last Reviewed
description: Date someone pressed "Mark reviewed".

name: Review Overdue
description: Next Review Date is in the past.

name: Created At
description: Timestamp when the item was created.

name: Created By
description: User who created the item (or the AI intake on their behalf).

name: Last Edited By
description: User who last changed the item.

name: Phase Changed At
description: When the Phase last changed.

name: Days in Current Phase
description: Days since Phase Changed At.

name: Item Age (days)
description: Days since Created At.

name: Status Changed At
description: When Status or Health last changed.

name: Created Via
description: How the item entered the platform.

name: AI Draft (needs review)
description: True while AI-filled values have not been confirmed by a person.

name: Source Document
description: Original email/document/URL the item was created from (stored file or link).

name: Archived
description: Soft delete. Hidden from grids by default, kept for history.

name: Home Project
githubSync: Selects the repo for the tracking issue.
description: Project that owns the item (team, repo, GitHub setup).

name: Contributing Teams
description: Teams whose capacity the item needs.

name: Rank in Project
description: Position of the item within its project, from the global Stack Rank.

name: Previous Rank
description: Stack Rank in the previous cycle.

name: Value Proposition (customer-safe)
description: One or two sentences on the benefit, safe to show customers.

name: Target Segments (customer-safe)
description: Who it is for, in customer-safe wording.

name: Screenshots
githubSync: Share links (not the files) go into the issue's Files section, in private repositories only.
description: Images of the proposed solution.

name: Date Precision
description: How exact dates may be shown outside the team.

name: Effort by Skill
description: Person-weeks per skill (backend, frontend, data, platform).

name: Fit by Team
description: Per-team result of the capacity check at this rank.

name: Spec Status
allowedText: No spec · Draft · In review · Approved
description: State of the item documents.

name: Documents
allowedText: PRD, business requirements, technical requirements, acceptance criteria, prototype, research
githubSync: Links may be added to the issue body.
description: Item documents (links or MD files), versioned.

name: Ready for Build
description: Definition of Ready complete and approved.

name: Ready for Build By / At
description: Approver and time of approval.

name: Agent-ready
description: Spec, criteria and breakdown complete so a coding agent can start.

name: Breakdown Route
description: Who breaks the initiative into epics and tasks.

name: Breakdown Status
allowedText: Not started · Draft proposed · Awaiting engineering · Complete
githubSync: Complete can be set by label or in the app.
description: Progress of the breakdown.

name: Planned Scope (#)
description: Sub-issues existing when breakdown became Complete.

name: Planning Status
allowedText: Backlog · Not started · Candidate · Included · Committed · Deferred · Dropped
description: Where the item stands before and during planning: Backlog and Not started first, then the planning cycle (Candidate to Dropped).

name: Cycle
description: Cycle the item is planned in.

name: Candidate Tag
allowedText: Carry-over · Likely carry-over · Deferred · New · Backlog
description: Why the item is in the candidate pool.

name: Deferred Count
description: How many cycles the item has been pushed out.

name: Deferral Reason
description: Why the item was deferred.

name: Added After Commit
description: Item entered the cycle after the Commit date.

name: Current Gate
description: Next gate the item must pass.

name: Gate Status
allowedText: Not started · In review · Waiting for Approver · Passed with conditions · Passed · Held · Stopped
description: State of the current gate.

name: Next Gate Due
description: Date the next gate decision is due.

name: Alignment Status
allowedText: Not started · In review · Aligned · Contested · Overdue
description: Overall state across Why, What, How and When.

name: Why State
allowedText: Not started · In review · Aligned · Contested · Overdue
description: Is it worth doing? Ranking and coins.

name: What State
allowedText: Not started · In review · Aligned · Contested · Overdue
description: Do we mean the same thing? Brief review.

name: How State
allowedText: Not started · In review · Aligned · Contested · Overdue
description: Can we build it safely? Engineering, design, security, legal.

name: When State
allowedText: Not started · In review · Aligned · Contested · Overdue
description: Does it fit? Team leads confirm capacity.

name: Outcome Status
allowedText: Not yet due · On target · Behind · Missed · Exceeded
description: Result of the latest outcome review.

name: Outcome Review Date
description: Date of the next outcome review.

name: Value vs Prediction (%)
description: Realised value compared with the predicted value.

name: Time to First Use (days)
description: Days from launch to first customer use.

name: Retention (%)
description: Share of adopters still using it.

name: Created Via Values
allowedText: UI · Import · Claude (MCP) · GitHub · API · System
description: Extend Created Via (N29) with Claude (MCP).

name: Locked (GitHub-driven)
description: True for fields set by GitHub (status, progress, PR, CI).

name: Initiative Status
githubSync: Not synced. A closed linked ticket only sets Build Status and Build Completed; people decide where the initiative itself stands.
description: Whether the initiative is alive, set by people: Active, On hold or Cancelled. Completed and Sunset come from Initiative Phase; Backlog and Not started are Planning Status. A closed GitHub or Jira ticket only means the build is done: see Build Status.

name: Description
githubSync: App -> GitHub: own section 'Description' of the managed block of the issue body (Markdown). Do not put value, customers or decisions in it.
description: The technical description that engineers and agents work from, written in Markdown (headings, lists, links, tables). It becomes its own section of the tracking issue. It is visible to everyone who can see the issue, so keep value, customers and decisions out of it.

storage: Derived in the app from the GitHub link (not stored)
name: Last Synced
githubSync: Not synced: shown from the GitHub link, read-only.
filledWhen: After the first send or check
description: When this initiative was last in step with its tracker: the latest of the last confirmed send and the last time GitHub's changes were applied. Empty when it is not on a tracker.

storage: Derived in the app from the GitHub link (not stored)
name: Synced With
githubSync: Not synced: shown from the GitHub link, read-only.
filledWhen: After the first send or check
description: Where this initiative syncs to, for example GitHub, the repository, and the Project board it is on. Says when the last send failed or when it only follows an issue read-only.
